store.description: Path to nexus_store directory. null = default (./nexus_store relative to project root).

ingestion.description: Maximum characters per chunk. Friendly to small-context local LLMs.

watchkeeper.description: Default scan interval in seconds. auto_start = start on Nexus init.

semantic.description: Semantic search settings. sentence_transformers gives better results but requires pip install.

ocr.description: OCR settings. null = auto-select best available engine.
